title: centaurea tenacissima
intro: Centaurea tenacissima, commonly known as Balkan centaury, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat a range of health issues. The health benefits of Centaurea tenacissima include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing stress and anxiety, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
